findings.message: The acceptance test only asserts the deny reason does not name the parallel task or the two gates; it never asserts the write is allowed (denyReason undefined) or that the launcher exited 0, so a crashed hook with empty stdout, or a deny on another rule, passes vacuously. Acceptance criterion 1 says the active task writes its planned file; assert denyReason(write.stdout) === undefined (as consumer-enforcement.test.ts does for its allowed control) and check write.code.
